<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown daemon --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown daemon [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--port <PORT>`
: Port for the web UI on 127.0.0.1. Default: `8787`.

`--rescan-every <RESCAN_EVERY>`
: Rescan each drive this often (e.g. 12h, 1d; `never` to scan only on request or when a drive comes back). Default: `24h`.

`--system`
: Machine-wide service: index in /var/lib/backdown, socket in /run/backdown, shared with the `backdown` group (set by the system unit).

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

One job at a time (scan, hash, recognise, copy, mirror, wipe), so the index has a single writer and each drive a single reader; rescues and drive-health readings run beside them. Every scan is followed by hashing, and recognition when something changed. On Linux and macOS the CLI talks to it through a socket in your runtime folder; on Windows, commands use the index directly.

## Examples

```sh
# usually started by `backdown service install`; by hand:
backdown daemon
backdown daemon --rescan-every 12h
# scan only when asked, or when a drive comes back
backdown daemon --rescan-every never
```
